Vat.title: VAT summary
Vat.body: The VAT summary of a document: per rate the base and the tax on it, then the total. The total is the sum of the per-line taxes and therefore agrees with them exactly. Amounts appear in the document's own currency. Special cases such as reverse charge or import carry their badge; a document without VAT says so explicitly.
